messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE to #incidents: SEV2 — sudden GPU capacity shortfall in us-west causing queue growth and degraded throughput. Trigger: autoscaler error 'thin provisioning limit exceeded'. Automatic fallback attempted.

maya (oncall): seeing huge backlog on inference-queue-usw. Is fallback actually active?

ryan: fallback tried but a few pv/gpu allocations still fail. logs show failure to attach GPUs on some hosts.

elaine: adding context: churn started ~1837603000, increased after a batch of preemptions from cloud provider. Autoscaler tried to spin new nodes but got quota errors for accelerator quota.

samir: quoted error from autoscaler: `ErrorAllocate: requestedAcceleratorQuotaExceedsLimit (code 403)` — looks quota per-project hit.

maya (oncall): ok — immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle low-priority tenants, 2) shift traffic to dedicated fallback region us-east, 3) request temporary quota bump with cloud console (takes ~10-30m). I'll start (1) now.

marta: support-team notified customers with affected SLAs? support-team: we have 3 active customers with high throughput in us-west — I'm drafting a short notification (ETA ~5m).

ops-bot: throttle policy applied: `policy: drop-non-critical=75%` to routes: embed-prod, analytics-ingest.

ryan: confirmed throttle reduced queue growth by ~40%. KPIs: p50 latency 230ms -> 400ms for affected routes, overall token throughput down 28%.

maya (oncall): starting on-call handoff: @elaine you're up for postmortem lead when we stabilize? I need to hand to morning crew at 0600.

elaine: I can take postmortem. I'll coordinate with infra/sre. Please capture timeline and any logs.

samir: while we wait on quota bump, can we enable regional spill to us-east for canary customers? Need config change in routing: `route: fallback_region=us-east priority=low`

marta: support-team: sent initial customer message: "We're investigating degraded throughput in us-west, applying mitigations that may reduce traffic for non-critical workloads. We'll post updates in 15 minutes."

incident-bot: cloud-quota-request: ticket#INC-7832 created for accelerator quota bump (provider request id 9f3e). Estimated response 12-25 minutes.

ryan: executed temporary routing change for test-tenant-1 -> us-east. Verified end-to-end, latency 420ms but stable.

maya (oncall): update: quota ticket responded — provisional bump approved for +6 GPUs, ETA ~8m for provisioning. If that lands, autoscaler should be able to fill slow paths.

elaine: starting an actions tracker in thread. Please add owners and ETA inline.

elaine: ACTION 1 — Confirm root cause (provider preemptions + project quota limits) and document exact sequence. Owner: samir. ETA: 2026-03-16 14:00 UTC.

elaine: ACTION 2 — Improve autoscaler error handling: when quota errors appear, automatically trigger spill-to-region policy and create ticket with provider. Owner: ryan. ETA: 2026-03-23.

elaine: ACTION 3 — Add a fall-through numeric budget in our infra to reserve emergency spare GPUs per region (thin-provision guard). Owner: infra-pager. ETA: 2026-04-06.

elaine: ACTION 4 — Customer communications template for GPU capacity incidents, include explicit SLO impact calc. Owner: marta / support-team. ETA: 2026-03-18.

samir: captured logs and sequence in /var/logs/incidents/1837604321.log and pushed to ephemeral storage: s3://redwood-incidents/1837604321/logs.tar.gz

maya (oncall): handoff note for morning crew: state=stabilized, throttles still applied, quota bump pending final provisioning. Please don't revert throttles until confirmed capacity is healthy.

ops-bot: autoscaler event stream: `PROVISION_ATTEMPT -> QUOTA_FAIL -> TICKET_CREATED -> THROTTLE_APPLIED -> SPILL_STARTED -> PROVISION_SUCCESS`

support-team: have an internal thread with the 3 affected customers and set expectations: next update in 30m or after provisioning.

elaine: scheduling postmortem: proposed slot 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC, invites to infra, oncall, support, product eng. Objections?

ryan: works for me. I'll prepare a short runbook PR for the spill config change.

marta: works for support. I'll bring customer timeline and messages.

samir: will attach provider telemetry and preemption snapshot to the postmortem doc.

maya (oncall): final: thanks everyone for quick coord. I'll escalate any late issues to the morning pager. Closing thread for now but leaving actions open. :white_check_mark:

infra-pager: noted. Leaving follow-ups in the remediation board: https://redwood-internal/boards/remediation/1837604321

incident-bot: thread closed by maya (oncall)."
